plugins.name: laya
plugins.description: A skill for writing and improving programs that call Laya and laya-cli — local, typed decisions with Choice/Score/Noul.

plugins.name: laya-browser-use
plugins.description: Fast browser actions with local Laya via laya-cli — no API key, no network for decisions. Requires Computer Use and laya-cli.

plugins.name: subagents
plugins.description: Orchestrator/subagent coordination workflow using Claude Code's Agent tool (fork, subagent_type, isolation, ListAgents, SendMessage). Use only when the user asks for subagents.

plugins.name: laya-model-routing
plugins.description: Pick the cheapest model that's good enough for a task using local Laya (difficulty/kind/risk in one request) before delegating work or spawning a subagent.
